capture_plan_law: One pipeline run per case; the four planted defect classes must be REJECTED and the production cases must PASS through this exact template path (prereg -> capture -> two-stage gate -> receipts -> review export). Production cases carry the ACTUAL committed capture frames of the frozen 39-frame plan (prereg section 3) re-bound from the sealed run's own frames artifact: V1 carries the 29 clean motion-axis frames + 3 diagnostic frames, V2 the 2 clean + 1 diagnostic detail frames, V3 the 2 clean + 2 diagnostic alternate-angle frames (the repeatability pairs ride their family case). exception_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 exception law: a frame passes only via an exception declared in the view-spec; every exception pass emits a machine receipt row with census evidence; prose-only exceptions are refused. This profile declares NO occluder (A6): expected_occluded is empty in every class and occlusion_or_xray_mode is depth_tested on every manifest row.
freeze_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 prereg law: thresholds are frozen in the view-spec; the gate never adjusts a threshold to pass an observed frame; any change mints spec_version+1 and a new prereg hash. Floors were calibrated once from the resumed attempt's unsealed dev capture of the same frozen frame plan (29/3/2/1/2/2 frames, measured minima body 386/400/6249/6230/136/136, layers 45323/9537/44927) and pinned at half-to-decade margins BELOW the minima BEFORE any sealed capture; no sealed frame adjusted a threshold.
